rachel (Docs): FYI opened a PR to add a "Kubernetes operator" how-to for Dedicated pools, plus a Go SDK example and a short checklist for customers migrating from shared. Need infra + ops review. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/1402

samir (Infra): nice initiative. Which operator knobs are you documenting? replicas, nodeSelectors, and preemptible fallback?

rachel (Docs): yes 100%: replicas, pod anti-affinity, nodeSelectors for GPU type, plus recommended liveness probes and fallback routing. Also included a Helm values snippet.

lucy (SRE): for probes include a GPU health probe example (exit code on driver error). Also recommend HPA triggers based on p95 latency or queue_depth, not p50.

rachel (Docs): updated HPA recommendation to p95 and added a GPU health probe sample. Can you review the Helm snippet?

samir (Infra): quick provider note: operator should call the infra API to create the pool (redwood_dedicated_pool) and then annotate the k8s service with pool_id. In examples, prefer kms_key_arn and burst_config block.

rachel (Docs): changed Terraform/Helm to use kms_key_arn and burst_config. Helm values example: 

```yaml
redwood:
  pool:
    name: "k8s-dedicated"
    gpuType: "a100-80gb"
    minCapacity: 3
    maxCapacity: 12
    burstConfig:
      enabled: true
      maxBurst: 6
    kmsKeyArn: "arn:aws:kms:...:key/abcd"
```

nate (Platform): small infra check: pool annotation should be "redwood.pool/id" and operator needs permissions to call attach_model for pinning. Add that to the RBAC checklist.

rachel (Docs): added RBAC checklist: operator service account needs infra:create_pool, infra:attach_model, and kms:Decrypt for provided KMS key.

ivy (Support): spotted a broken link in the migration checklist pointing to /pricing/dedicated; replaced with /pricing/dedicated-reserved. Also add a migration step: validate kms:Encrypt/decrypt from customer's account.

rachel (Docs): added encrypt/decrypt validation step and fixed the pricing link. Thanks.

lucy (SRE): include a concrete rollback trigger for the operator: "if GPU error rate > 5% for 3m or healthy_pods < 2 for 5m, operator should switch traffic to Hosted route and emit an incident event."

rachel (Docs): added that rollback procedure. Also included a Go SDK snippet for creating a pool and attaching a model: 

```go
import (
  "context"
  infra "github.com/redwood/infra-go"
)

func createPool() {
  client := infra.NewClient(nil)
  cfg := infra.ProvisioningConfig{
    GPUType: "a100-80gb",
    MinCapacity: 3,
    MaxCapacity: 12,
    BurstConfig: &infra.BurstConfig{Enabled: true, MaxBurst: 6},
    KMSKeyArn: "arn:aws:kms:...:key/abcd",
  }
  pool, _ := client.CreatePool(context.Background(), infra.CreatePoolParams{Name: "k8s-dedicated", ProvisioningConfig: cfg})
  client.AttachModel(context.Background(), infra.AttachModelParams{PoolID: pool.ID, ModelID: "redwood/gptx:2026-04-01", Pinned: true})
}
```

samir (Infra): Go API shapes look right, small tweak: CreatePool returns (*Pool, error) and AttachModel param name is AttachModelRequest. Also mention that pinned models are bound to the pool's SLA.

rachel (Docs): updated wording: pinned models are bound to the pool SLA and inherit fallback behaviour. Added note about SLA table row: "Burst fallback: latency SLOs may be relaxed up to 30% during preemptible fallback; burst minutes are pro-rated per-minute."

lucy (SRE): add isolation clarification: "Dedicated guarantees tenant-isolated GPU allocation and ephemeral KV caches. Control-plane logs/metrics are aggregated for platform health, but tenant audit logs and access to model artifacts are restricted via RBAC and KMS."

rachel (Docs): added isolation paragraph and a short customer-facing billing example: "Estimated monthly impact = 9reserved_commit_cost + expected_burst_minutes * burst_price_per_min." linked to pricing doc.

ivy (Support): approve customer-facing bits. One more ask: include a sample troubleshooting command for the operator to surface pod GPU driver errors.

rachel (Docs): added a sample kubectl logs + GPU driver grep snippet. CI triggered.

ci-bot: docs CI passed https://ci.internal/builds/5267 :white_check_mark:

rachel (Docs): thanks all 14 merging now. I'll post the playbook in #customer-success and add a short note to the operator's README pointing to the pricing and SLA pages. :rocket:
